meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：There is good reason to + base verb + other information。

rules.zh: to 後面使用動詞原形 正確： 錯誤：
rules.en: Use the base form of the verb after to. Correct: There is good reason to wait. There is good reason to believe him. There is good reason to be cautious. Incorrect: There is good reason to waiting. There is good reason to believed him. There is good reason to being cautious.
examples: There is good reason to wait.
There is good reason to believe him.
There is good reason to be cautious.
There is good reason to waiting.
There is good reason to believed him.
There is good reason to being cautious.

rules.zh: there 是形式主語 這裏的 there 並不表示「那裏」。 意思不是「那裏有理由等待」，而是： 有充分理由等待。
rules.en: There is a dummy subject here; it does not mean a place. “There is good reason to wait” means that sufficient reason to wait exists, not that a reason is located “there”.
examples: There is good reason to wait.

rules.zh: good reason 前通常不加 a 表示存在充分、合理的依據，重點是「理由充分」。 （有充分理由懷疑這份報告。） 通常表示有一個具體或特定的理由。 （取消會議是有一個充分理由的。我稍後會解釋。） 兩者意思接近，但本課集中練習：
rules.en: Normally omit a before good reason in the target structure. “There is good reason to ...” emphasises that sufficient, valid grounds exist: There is good reason to doubt the report. “There is a good reason to ...” normally points to one specific reason: There is a good reason to cancel the meeting. I will explain it later. This lesson focuses on There is good reason to ....
examples: There is good reason to ...
There is good reason to doubt the report.
There is a good reason to ...
There is a good reason to cancel the meeting. I will explain it later.

rules.zh: 常接表示判斷、預期或審慎態度的動詞 常見搭配包括：
rules.en: The structure commonly takes verbs of judgement, expectation or caution. Common combinations include: There is good reason to believe ...; to expect ...; to suspect ...; to question ...; to doubt ...; to be cautious; to be concerned; and to reconsider the decision.
examples: There is good reason to believe ...
There is good reason to expect ...
There is good reason to suspect ...
There is good reason to question ...
There is good reason to doubt ...
There is good reason to be cautious.
There is good reason to be concerned.
There is good reason to reconsider the decision.

rules.zh: 與 for good reason 及 for no good reason 的分別 這是一個完整句型，直接表示：存在充分理由去做某事或相信某事。 （有充分理由保持審慎。） 重點是提出或確認「充分理由存在」。 這是一個副詞短語，修飾前面的行動、態度或描述，意思是： 有充分理由地；這樣做是有道理的。 （她十分審慎，而且這樣做是有充分理由的。） （這條道路被視為危險道路，而且這個看法是有充分理由的。） 它通常不是用來直接帶出下一個動作，而是補充說明前面的行動或看法是合理的。 這也是副詞短語，意思是： 沒有任何充分理由；無緣無故。 它通常帶有批評意味，表示某項行為並不合理。 （他毫無充分理由地取消了預約。） （她無緣無故地生氣。） D. 真正相反的句型 There is good reason to ... 的直接否定形式是： （沒有充分理由恐慌。） 因此： ● There is good reason to ...：有充分理由做…… ● There is no good reason to ...：沒有充分理由做…… ● for good reason：某項行動是有充分理由的 ● for no good reason：某項行動毫無充分理由
rules.en: Distinguish the related expressions. A. There is good reason to ... is a complete structure asserting that sufficient grounds exist for an action or belief: There is good reason to be cautious. B. For good reason is an adverbial phrase that comments that a preceding action, attitude or description is justified: She was cautious, and for good reason. The road is considered dangerous, and for good reason. It normally comments on what came before rather than introducing the next action. C. For no good reason means without any valid reason and often criticises an unjustified action: He cancelled the appointment for no good reason. She became angry for no good reason. D. The direct opposite of There is good reason to ... is There is no good reason to ...: There is no good reason to panic. In short: There is good reason to ... means sufficient grounds exist; There is no good reason to ... means they do not; for good reason says an action is justified; for no good reason says it is unjustified.
examples: A. There is good reason to ...
There is good reason to be cautious.
B. for good reason
She was cautious, and for good reason.
The road is considered dangerous, and for good reason.
C. for no good reason
He cancelled the appointment for no good reason.
She became angry for no good reason.
There is no good reason to ...
There is no good reason to panic.

benefits.zh: 讓你的看法聽起來有根據 這個句型能表示你的判斷並非純粹來自個人感覺，而是有證據、事實或合理情況支持。 （我認為這些數字可能有錯。） （有充分理由相信這些數字可能有錯。） 第二句更清楚地表示這個判斷有一定根據。
benefits.en: It makes an opinion sound well founded by showing that evidence, facts or reasonable circumstances support the judgement rather than mere personal feeling. Compare: I think the figures may be wrong. There is good reason to believe the figures may be wrong. The second sentence makes the evidential basis clearer.

benefits.zh: 適合提出審慎的判斷 你可以用它表達「相信」、「預期」、「懷疑」或「質疑」，而不需要把事情說成百分之百確定。 （有充分理由懷疑這個帳戶已受到入侵。） 這種說法能保持審慎，避免在證據不足時作出過分肯定的結論。
benefits.en: It suits cautious judgements. You can use it with believing, expecting, suspecting or questioning without claiming absolute certainty: There is good reason to suspect that the account has been compromised. This wording avoids an overly definite conclusion when the evidence is incomplete.

benefits.zh: 提出建議時不會過分強硬 它可以說明某項行動是合理的，而不是直接命令別人。 較直接： （你必須檢討預算。） 較客觀： （有充分理由檢討預算。） 第二句把焦點放在理由上，因此語氣較客觀。
benefits.en: It makes a suggestion less forceful by presenting an action as reasonable instead of issuing a direct command. More direct: You must review the budget. More objective: There is good reason to review the budget. The second sentence focuses on the grounds for acting.

benefits.zh: 能把背景和結論清楚連接起來 你可以先提出證據、情況或問題，再說明甚麼行動是合理的。 （鑑於成本上升，有充分理由檢討預算。） 讀者可以立即明白「成本上升」和「檢討預算」之間的關係。
benefits.en: It clearly connects context with a conclusion. State the evidence, situation or problem first and then identify the reasonable action: Given the rising costs, there is good reason to review the budget. The relationship between rising costs and reviewing the budget is immediately clear.

benefits.zh: 適合作文、報告、會議和正式討論 這個句型特別適合用來： ● 分析證據； ● 提出建議； ● 評估風險； ● 解釋為何應採取行動； ● 表達有根據但仍然審慎的判斷。 它亦能減少反覆使用：
benefits.en: It suits essays, reports, meetings and formal discussions. Use it to analyse evidence, make recommendations, evaluate risks, explain why action should be taken, or express a well-founded but cautious judgement. It also avoids repeatedly using I think ..., We should ..., It is reasonable to ..., or It makes sense to ....

questions.answer: There is good reason to inform residents before changing the collection schedule.
questions.answerZh: 有充分理由在更改收集時間表前通知居民。
questions.highlight: There is good reason to inform residents before changing the collection schedule.

questions.prompt: The fact that children regularly cross this road justifies installing clearer warning signs.
questions.promptZh: 兒童經常橫過這條道路，因此安裝更清晰的警告標誌是合理的。
questions.answer: Where children regularly cross the road, there is good reason to install clearer warning signs.
questions.answerZh: 在兒童經常橫過道路的地方，有充分理由安裝更清晰的警告標誌。
questions.highlight: Where children regularly cross the road, there is good reason to install clearer warning signs.

questions.prompt: The lack of staff raises valid doubts about whether the plan can succeed.
questions.promptZh: 人手不足令人有合理理由懷疑這項計劃能否成功。
questions.answer: There is good reason to question whether the plan can succeed without enough staff.
questions.answerZh: 有充分理由質疑這項計劃能否在人手不足的情況下成功。
questions.highlight: There is good reason to question whether the plan can succeed without enough staff.

questions.prompt: The repeated delays justify examining how the orders are being processed.
questions.promptZh: 多次出現延誤，因此有理由檢查訂單的處理方式。
questions.answer: In light of the repeated delays, there is good reason to examine how the orders are being processed.
questions.answerZh: 鑑於多次出現延誤，有充分理由檢查訂單的處理方式。
questions.highlight: In light of the repeated delays, there is good reason to examine how the orders are being processed.

questions.prompt: Although the first report looked reassuring, waiting for the independent review is sensible.
questions.promptZh: 雖然第一份報告看來令人安心，但等待獨立檢討仍是明智的。
questions.answer: Although the first report looked reassuring, there is good reason to wait for the independent review.
questions.answerZh: 雖然第一份報告看來令人安心，但仍有充分理由等待獨立檢討。
questions.highlight: Although the first report looked reassuring, there is good reason to wait for the independent review.

questions.prompt: Reports from several reliable sources justify taking the warning seriously.
questions.promptZh: 數個可靠消息來源都作出相關報道，因此認真看待這項警告是合理的。
questions.answer: When several reliable sources report the same problem, there is good reason to take the warning seriously.
questions.answerZh: 當數個可靠消息來源都報道同一問題時，有充分理由認真看待這項警告。
questions.highlight: When several reliable sources report the same problem, there is good reason to take the warning seriously.

questions.prompt: Uncertainty about future demand makes avoiding a large immediate investment sensible.
questions.promptZh: 未來需求存在不確定性，因此避免立即作出大額投資是明智的。
questions.answer: Given the uncertainty about future demand, there is good reason to avoid making a large investment immediately.
questions.answerZh: 鑑於未來需求存在不確定性，有充分理由避免立即作出大額投資。
questions.highlight: Given the uncertainty about future demand, there is good reason to avoid making a large investment immediately.

questions.prompt: The current evidence supports the belief that the policy will affect small businesses more than large companies.
questions.promptZh: 現有證據支持這個看法：這項政策對小型企業的影響將大於大型公司。
questions.answer: There is good reason to believe that the policy will affect small businesses more than large companies.
questions.answerZh: 有充分理由相信這項政策對小型企業的影響將大於大型公司。
questions.highlight: There is good reason to believe that the policy will affect small businesses more than large companies.

questions.prompt: The mismatch between the records justifies investigating whether any payments are missing.
questions.promptZh: 紀錄互不相符，因此調查是否有付款遺失是合理的。
questions.answer: Because the records do not match, there is good reason to investigate whether any payments are missing.
questions.answerZh: 由於紀錄互不相符，有充分理由調查是否有付款遺失。
questions.highlight: Because the records do not match, there is good reason to investigate whether any payments are missing.

questions.prompt: The equipment failed during two safety tests, so replacing it before the next inspection is justified.
questions.promptZh: 設備在兩次安全測試中發生故障，因此在下次檢查前更換設備是合理的。
questions.answer: After the equipment failed during two safety tests, there is good reason to replace it before the next inspection.
questions.answerZh: 設備在兩次安全測試中發生故障後，有充分理由在下次檢查前更換設備。
questions.highlight: After the equipment failed during two safety tests, there is good reason to replace it before the next inspection.

questions.prompt: If a decision could affect vulnerable residents, consulting them before taking action is appropriate and justified.
questions.promptZh: 如果某項決定可能影響弱勢居民，在採取行動前諮詢他們是恰當而合理的。
questions.answer: If a decision could affect vulnerable residents, there is good reason to consult them before taking action.
questions.answerZh: 如果某項決定可能影響弱勢居民，有充分理由在採取行動前諮詢他們。
questions.highlight: If a decision could affect vulnerable residents, there is good reason to consult them before taking action.

questions.prompt: The conflicting medical advice makes it sensible to seek a second professional opinion.
questions.promptZh: 互相矛盾的醫療建議，令尋求另一名專業人士的意見成為明智做法。
questions.answer: In view of the conflicting medical advice, there is good reason to seek a second professional opinion.
questions.answerZh: 鑑於醫療建議互相矛盾，有充分理由尋求另一名專業人士的意見。
questions.highlight: In view of the conflicting medical advice, there is good reason to seek a second professional opinion.

questions.prompt: Although the project has made progress, the unfinished key tests justify reconsidering the deadline.
questions.promptZh: 雖然項目已有進展，但關鍵測試尚未完成，因此重新考慮限期是合理的。
questions.answer: Even though the project has made progress, there is good reason to reconsider the deadline if key tests remain unfinished.
questions.answerZh: 即使項目已有進展，如果關鍵測試仍未完成，也有充分理由重新考慮限期。
questions.highlight: Even though the project has made progress, there is good reason to reconsider the deadline if key tests remain unfinished.
